title: Understand startup and synchronization progress

summary.text: Verifying stored blocks, replaying ledger state and downloading new blocks are different stages. A slow stage alone does not prove that data is corrupt.

problem.text: Sync stuck slow frozen loading verifying blockchain replaying ledger connecting to network

symptoms.text: Sync stuck slow frozen loading verifying blockchain replaying ledger connecting to network

user_phrases.text: Sync stuck slow frozen loading verifying blockchain replaying ledger connecting to network

daedalus.notes: Interface source inspected at Daedalus 11.0.0. Later versions and specific OS releases require another review; safety advice is Ariadne editorial policy.

causes.claim: A symptom alone does not establish a cause.

resolutions.action: Note the phase shown on screen and whether progress changes over time.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: Check Diagnostics for node status, synchronization, available disk space and time status. Record the Daedalus version and your operating system.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: If progress remains unchanged, contact support with the phase, elapsed time and any exact error. Do not delete blockchain or wallet data as a generic fix.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

expected_outcome.text: You can describe the stalled stage to staff without changing wallet files. There is no guaranteed synchronization time in the checked source.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

prerequisites: Use the genuine application and keep private backups private.
consequences: Changing or approving wallet operations can affect funds.
recovery: Stop if unsure; contact human support before changing wallet data.

evidence.rationale: Official source inspection and Ariadne safety review; not wallet runtime testing.

faq.reason: Conservative source-reviewed introduction; not an exhaustive troubleshooting procedure.
